decisions.description: Mercy MVP v1 does not integrate ESIA and privileged role activation uses confirmed account email plus role approval.
Mercy MVP v1 does not implement Alexandra-specific home questionnaire, mandatory video call or pair visit requirements.
Do not merge PR #125; prepare distinct draft PR #243 branched from actual main. Do not merge without new user directive.
Maintain case-scoped audited access, contact privacy, consent and existing moderation.
